signature.name: VTask.weierstrassPSeries
signature.type: (L : PeriodPair) -> (x : ℂ) -> FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ ℂ

conventions.statement: The zeroth coefficient is the value of the Weierstrass elliptic function ℘ at x, not the value of the general-index formula (i+1)*sumInvPow x (i+2).
conventions.note: Special-cased at index zero because ℘ has an Eisenstein correction term not captured by sumInvPow alone.

facts.statement: ¬ ∀ (L : PeriodPair) (x : ℂ), (VTask.weierstrassPSeries L x 0 (fun _ => 1) : ℂ) = L.sumInvPow x 2

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∃ (L : PeriodPair) (x : ℂ), (VTask.weierstrassPSeries L x 0 (fun _ => 1)) ≠ (L.sumInvPow x 2 : ℂ)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.violated_property: The zeroth coefficient equals ℘(x), not sumInvPow x 2; the two branches differ at i=0
